definitions.explanation: The biological kingdom of organisms that includes molds, yeasts, and mushrooms. In everyday Japanese, most commonly encountered in medical contexts — fungal infections of the skin, nails, or internal organs.

examples.japanese: {真菌|しんきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感染|かんせん}した→感染する：26931_kansensuru⟧。
⟦{水虫|みずむし}→水虫：27212_mizumushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{真菌|しんきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皮膚|ひふ}→皮膚：03987_hifu⟧{病|びょう}だ。
examples.english: Athlete's foot is a skin disease caused by fungus.

examples.japanese: ⟦{湿度|しつど}→湿度：03181_shitsudo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{真菌|しんきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{繁殖|はんしょく}→繁殖：08671_hanshoku⟧しやすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{換気|かんき}→換気：00172_kanki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}をつけて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Fungi multiply easily in humid environments, so please pay attention to ventilation.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{真|しん}→真：28884_shin⟧ (true) and ⟦{菌|きん}→菌：02682_kin⟧ (germ, fungus). The term {真菌|しんきん} distinguishes fungi as a separate biological kingdom from bacteria (⟦{細菌|さいきん}→細菌：13791_saikin⟧). In daily life, the word appears most often in medical and health contexts — discussing skin infections, mold problems, or food science.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真菌|しんきん}⟦{感染|かんせん}{症|しょう}→感染症：15681_kansenshou⟧: fungal infection
- {真菌|しんきん}⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧: fungi (as a group)
- {抗|こう}{真菌|しんきん}{薬|やく}: antifungal medication
- {真菌|しんきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{繁殖|はんしょく}→繁殖：08671_hanshoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: fungi proliferate

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{細菌|さいきん}→細菌：13791_saikin⟧: bacteria — often confused with fungi, but a different kingdom
- ⟦カビ→カビ：07055_kabi⟧: mold — the everyday word for visible fungal growth
- {酵母|こうぼ}: yeast — a type of fungus used in fermentation
- きのこ: mushroom — the fruiting body of certain fungi
